'''Stanisław Łojasiewicz''' ({{small|Polish:}} {{IPAc-pl|'|ł|o|j|a|ś|e|w|i|cz}}; 9 October 1926 – 14 November 2002) was a Polish [[mathematician]], professor at the [[Jagiellonian University]] and a member of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] known for his work in [[real algebraic geometry]] and [[Distribution (mathematical analysis)|theory of distributions]].<ref name="pawlucki">{{citation|title=Stanisław Łojasiewicz (1926–2002)|language=Polish|url=http://main3.amu.edu.pl/~wiadmat/183-190_wp_wm39.pdf|first=Wieslaw|last=Pawłucki|journal=Roczniki Polskiego Towarzystwa Matematycznego|series=Ser. II: Wiadomości Matematyczne|volume=39|year=2003|pages=183–190}}.</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=58245 |title=prof. zw. dr hab. czł. rzecz. PAN Stanisław Łojasiewicz |language=pl |work=nauka-polska.pl |access-date=28 June 2026}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Stanisław Łojasiewicz was born in 1926 in [[Warsaw]] to father Stanisław, who served as captain in the [[Polish Armed Forces|Polish Army]]. In 1945, he was admitted to the [[Jagiellonian University]]. During his studies he was particularly interested in the theory of [[differential equation]]s and was influenced by [[Tadeusz Ważewski]]. In 1950, he was awarded a doctorate for his work in this branch of mathematics.<ref name=imuj>{{Cite web|url=https://im.uj.edu.pl/lojasiewicz/lojasiewicz |title=Stanisław Łojasiewicz |work=Instytut Matematyki UJ |access-date=28 June 2026}}</ref> 

==Career==
At the end of the 1950s, Łojasiewicz solved the [[problem of distribution division]] by [[analytic function]]s, introducing the [[%C5%81ojasiewicz inequality]]. Its solution opened the road to important results in the new theory of [[partial differential equations]]. The method established by Łojasiewicz led him to advance the theory of [[semianalytic set]]s, which opened an important chapter in modern analysis.<ref name="pawlucki"/> 

From 1956 to 1960, Łojasiewicz taught at universities in [[Kingston, Ontario|Kingston]], [[Chicago]], [[Berkeley, California|Berkeley]] and the [[Institute for Advanced Studies]] in [[Princeton, New Jersey|Princeton]].{{cn|date=June 2026}} In 1962, he became professor at the Jagiellonian University.<ref name=imuj/> In 1967-68, he worked at the [[Institut des Hautes Etudes Scientifiques]] where he produced an elegant proof of the [[Malgrange preparation theorem]].<ref name=pas>{{cite web|url=https://www.pas.va/en/academicians/deceased/lojasiewicz.html |title=Stanisław Łojasiewicz |work=Pontifical Academy of Sciences |access-date=28 June 2026}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
In 1970, Łojasiewicz delivered an invited address on the subject of [[subanalytic set|semianalytic geometry]] at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Nice, France.<ref name=pas/> In 1971, Łojasiewicz became a corresponding member of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] and in 1980, its full member.<ref name=imuj/>

In 1984, Łojasiewicz was awarded the [[Wacław Sierpiński]] Medal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ptm.org.pl/konkursy/wyklady-im-waclawa-sierpinskiego |title=Medal i wykład im. Wacława Sierpińskiego |work=Polish Mathematical Society |access-date=28 June 2026 |language= pl}}</ref> The following year, he accepted the [[Jurzykowski Prize]].{{cn|date=June 2026}} In 1998, he became the recipient of the [[Order of Polonia Restituta]] (Commander's Cross with Star).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP19980360495 |title=M.P. 1998 nr 36 poz. 495 |language=pl |work=ISAP |access-date=28 June 2026}}</ref>

==Death and legacy==
On 14 November 2002, Łojasiewicz died of [[heart attack]] when returning from a scientific conference in Italy. He was buried at the [[Rakowicki Cemetery]] in Kraków.<ref>{{cite book |last=Tkaczyński |first=Jan Wiktor |date=2018 |title=Pro Memoria III. Profesorowie Uniwersytetu Jagiellońskiego spoczywający na cmentarzach Krakowa 1803-2017 |trans-title=Pro Memoria III: Jagiellonian University Professors Buried at the Cemeteries of Kraków in 1803-2017  |language=pl |publisher=Wydawnictwo Uniwersytetu Jagiellońskiego |location=Kraków |isbn=978-83-233-4527-5 |page=183 |url= |access-date=}}</ref>

The ''Łojasiewicz Lectures''<ref name=imuj/> are a series of annual lectures in [[mathematics]] given at the [[Jagiellonian University]] in honour of Łojasiewicz.
